design.motif: A locksmith's restrained wool-and-enamel service surface: fine compressed felt tooth, one open curved shackle-seat impression, a broken sealing seam and a tiny brushed-brass edge accent. Emphasize release, not a repeating padlock or security guarantee. No words or symbols.

description.en: Fine compressed felt tooth, one open curved shackle-seat impression, a broken sealing seam and a tiny brushed-brass edge accent.
description.zh: 压实毡面的开口弧槽、断开的封缝与极少黄铜边光，呼应解除限制后的松动感。

design.rationale: The existing object, character or historical mark remains unchanged. Only a supporting working surface is interpreted from the product's purpose; no replacement Logo is generated.

description.en: Find quarantined macOS apps and interactively remove their quarantine flags.
description.zh: 扫描被 macOS 隔离的应用，交互式地批量解除隔离标记。

purpose.en: Review quarantine results for apps in /Applications and select trusted apps for batch removal of the quarantine attribute.
purpose.zh: 查看 /Applications 内应用的隔离检测结果，选择可信应用后批量移除隔离属性。

rights: Owner-commissioned Azure OpenAI generated decoration under applicable provider terms. No third-party reference image or font was submitted. Existing Logo, font and product rights are unchanged. Do not describe raster output as handmade SVG or assert exclusive trademark rights.

contrast.method: WCAG relative luminance on every native RGBA pixel composited over actual Hexly normal/hover surfaces, before the left-edge mask. Text remains fully opaque.

publication: Export-time record. Upload receipts and the site release establish subsequent publication.
